title: ToT Storefront content/chrome-assignments.json
description: Per-page header/footer variant overrides for raw-HTML pages (content/pages-html/**.html). Only pages that should differ from chrome.json's site-wide header.variant/footer.variant need an entry — everything else uses the site default. Requires chrome.v2.schema.json's header/footer variant contract.

assignments.description: Keyed by the page's full path: a required leading slash, no trailing slash, including any parent section (e.g. "/contact/contact-sales", NOT "/contact-sales"). Derive it from the page's file path under content/pages-html/: drop that prefix and ".html", keep the leading slash. Matching is exact after stripping a trailing slash only — no prefix or glob matching, so an assignment on a nested page never affects its parent or siblings.

entry.description: At least one of headerVariant/footerVariant must be set — an entry overriding neither overrides nothing.
